name: Backend Engineer Screening
steps: Access the ATS and filter for 'Backend Engineer' roles in the 'New' status.
Open each applicant's profile and locate the resume file.
Review the resume to determine the total years of Python experience.
Check the applicant profile or resume for any indication of a referral.
Apply the screening rules to determine if the candidate should be interviewed or rejected.
For interviews: Book a 30-minute slot on the calendar during allowed hours, update the ATS status to Interview, and send the invitation email.
For rejections: Update the ATS status to Rejected and queue the rejection email for owner approval.

fields.name: python_experience_years
fields.description: The total number of years of Python experience found in the resume.

fields.name: is_referred
fields.description: Whether the candidate was referred by someone.

interview_invite.subject: Interview Invitation: Backend Engineer Role
interview_invite.body: Hi {name}, we'd like to invite you for a 30-minute call. Your slot is booked for {slot}. {note} {subject_id}

rejection_email.subject: Application Update: Backend Engineer Role
rejection_email.body: Hi {name}, thank you for your interest. Unfortunately, we are not moving forward with your application at this time. {slot} {note} {subject_id}

notes: Referrals bypass the Python experience requirement.
Rejection emails require manual approval from Meera before being sent.
